description: Source code for the Camera3StreamSplitter class in Android, managing camera stream buffers, connections, and output surfaces.

classes.name: Camera3StreamSplitter
classes.description: Manages camera stream buffer splitting, output surface connections, and buffer lifecycle.

classes.name: Camera3StreamSplitter::OutputListener
classes.description: Listener for buffer release and death events on output buffer producers.

classes.name: Camera3StreamSplitter::BufferTracker
classes.description: Tracks buffer references, fences, and associated surfaces.

methods.description: Establishes connection with output surfaces, creates buffer queue, and initializes parameters.

methods.description: Disconnects all outputs, clears buffers, and resets state.

methods.description: Adds an output surface to the splitter.

methods.name: removeOutput

methods.name: removeOutputLocked
methods.description: Internal method to remove output surface with locking.

methods.name: outputBufferLocked

methods.name: getUniqueConsumerName

methods.description: Handles buffer release notification.

methods.name: attachBufferToOutputs
methods.description: Attaches a native buffer to multiple output surfaces.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable

methods.name: onFrameReplaced
